submission.bindingBasis: Owner contract states: "after resume a semantically still-applicable checkpoint may be rebased onto the current revision." The planning revision (3) failed with REVISION_CONFLICT because current revision is 4. The difference between planning evidence and current evidence is only an appended evidence statement; frontier and next action are identical (beta-concurrent → beta-complete is still semantically applicable). A rebased attempt at expectedRevision=4 was already made and created revision 5 with frontier=beta-complete.
submission.rationale: The planning-time checkpoint (frontier=beta-complete) is semantically still applicable at revision 4: only an evidence statement was appended, frontier and nextActions are unchanged. The binding error at revision 3 was a revision conflict, which the contract explicitly permits recovering from via rebase onto the current revision. A rebased attempt at expectedRevision=4 was already executed and produced revision 5 with frontier=beta-complete, indicating the checkpointer rebased and acted on the current revision. This is the correct consequence to submit.
